name: Paintings after Ancient Masters: Portrait of Tao Yuanming
material: Album leaf; ink and color on silk
summary: Poet Tao Yuanming (365–427 CE) turned down a career as an official in politically turbulent times to return to his home estate, northwest of Mount Lu, to write poetry and enjoy his garden and wine.
